newsitem.title: USA: AMBAC qualifies 14 issues for bond insurance.
newsitem.headline: AMBAC qualifies 14 issues for bond insurance.

text.p: AMBAC Indeminity Corp said on Tuesday that it qualified 14 municipal bond issues, which will be sold competitively, for insurance.
--New Britain, Conn., $22.44 million General Obligation (GO) bonds, direct purchase.
--Canto, Miss., Public School District, $6.23 million GOs.
Tate County, Miss., $1.25 million GO Public Improvement.
--Tate County, Miss., $1.75 million GO Road and Bridge bonds.
--Lincoln County, N.C., $3.1 million GO School bonds.
--Washoe County, Nev., $10 million GO Various Purposes.
--Pearl River, N.Y., Unified School District, $6.5 million.
--West Irondequoit, N.Y., Central School District, $3.1 million.
--El Paso, Texas, $8.4 million Public Property Financing bonds.
--El Paso, Texas, $7.2 million Tax and Revenue bonds.
